name: zero-memory
description: Persistent cross-session memory for Cursor: auto-briefing at session start, transcript auto-capture on stop, a health warning when the server is unreachable, a recall-first nudge on code search, and the memory-first working rule. The zero-memory MCP server (recall, build_context, remember) is registered in ~/.cursor/mcp.json at user scope, keeping plain tool names (a plugin-bundled server would namespace them).
